summary: Explore macro-econometric modeling and forecasting in our EViews course. Gain valuable insights and skills to enhance your economic analysis capabilities.
lede: Macro-Econometric Modeling and Forecasting Using EViews develops practical skills for analyzing historical economic relationships, producing dynamic forecasts, and simulating policy impacts. You will work with macroeconomic data and learn to address stationarity, multivariate relationships, volatility, cointegration, and out-of-sample forecasting using structured time-series methods. The course guides you through cleaning datasets, estimating and diagnosing models, and interpreting results in EViews. You will apply ARIMA, Structural VAR, Johansen cointegration, GARCH, and Impulse Response Functions to build forecasts, examine economic shocks, and support evidence-based decision-making.
audienceIntro: This advanced quantitative program is tailored for professionals who are responsible for analyzing economic data, building forecasting models, and advising leadership on macroeconomic risks.
modules: Cointegration and Vector Error Correction Models
prerequisites: Participants must have a working knowledge of basic statistics, OLS regression, and macroeconomic principles. Prior exposure to time-series data is highly recommended. No advanced programming experience is required, but participants must bring a laptop with EViews installed (trial or academic versions are acceptable) to complete the hands-on modeling exercises.
